name: Boze Systems Password Visibility Toggle
author: bozesystems

sections.description:
Boze Systems Password Visibility Toggle adds an eye button to the password field of the standard WP-Members login form. Click the button to show or hide the password, or use Tab followed by Enter or Space.

  • Requires the WP-Members Membership Plugin (wp-members).
  • Translatable labels with English source strings. Translations are provided through WordPress.org language packs when available.
  • Hides the password on form submission, reset, and page restoration.
  • No settings, external services, tracking, or additional runtime libraries.
  • Does not read, collect, store, log, or transmit password values. The existing login form still submits credentials normally.

This is an independent add-on and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the WP-Members author.

Scope

Supports the standard form with ID wpmem_login_form and password input named pwd. Registration, password-change forms, custom widgets, renamed forms, and forms inserted after page initialization are not supported. Themes must call the standard WordPress head and footer hooks.

日本語

WP-Members標準ログインフォームのパスワード欄に目のボタンを追加します。有効化するだけで利用でき、クリックまたはキーボードで表示・非表示を切り替えられます。承認済みの日本語言語パックが利用できる場合、ボタンの説明も日本語になります。言語パックがない場合は英語で表示します。

パスワードの収集・保存・外部送信は行いません。登録・パスワード変更・独自フォームは対象外です。WP-Members開発元とは独立した非公式アドオンです。
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WP-Members Membership Plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP using Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or copy the boze-systems-password-visibility-toggle directory into wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Boze Systems Password Visibility Toggle and reload the login page.

日本語: 管理画面の「プラグイン」→「新規追加」→「プラグインのアップロード」からZIPをインストールし、有効化してください。WP-Membersも有効化してください。
sections.faq:
How do I migrate from wp-members-password-eye or password-eye-for-wp-members?

Deactivate the old plugin before installing and activating this renamed plugin. WordPress treats the new directory as a separate plugin. Do not activate both at the same time. There are no plugin settings to migrate.

日本語: 旧版を無効化してから新しいZIPをインストール・有効化してください。旧版との同時有効化は避けてください。移行する設定データはありません。

Does this change authentication or save passwords?

No. It changes only the existing input’s display type. Authentication and submission remain the responsibility of the original form.

Why is the button missing?

Check that WP-Members is active and the standard login form is used. Clear page caches after updating. JavaScript must be enabled. Disable any previous password-toggle snippet to avoid duplicate controls from another implementation.

Can I use it with Code Snippets?

Do not enable an equivalent snippet at the same time as this plugin.

How do I remove it?

Deactivate and delete the plugin. It creates no database settings or tables.

Which PHP version is required?

PHP 8.2 or later is the supported baseline. The toggle does not technically require PHP 8.2-specific language features.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Rename to Boze Systems Password Visibility Toggle with a matching text domain and package directory.
  • Use WordPress.org language packs instead of bundled translations and custom text-domain loading.

1.0.3

  • Rename the plugin to Password Eye for WP-Members (password-eye-for-wp-members).
  • Prepare directory metadata, dependency declaration, and GPL license files.
  • Require WordPress 6.5 for built-in plugin dependency handling; retain PHP 8.2 as the supported baseline.
  • Translate accessible labels and synchronize them with visibility and pressed state.
  • Add Japanese translations, visible keyboard focus, and a minimum 44-pixel input height.
  • Keep the existing input and native submission behavior; prevent duplicate initialization.

1.0.2

  • Set the minimum PHP version to 8.2.

1.0.1

  • Set the author name and author URL.

1.0.0

  • Initial password visibility toggle for the standard WP-Members login form.
